items.title: Mirror of t-20260908-kb-v2-repo-decision - which repo the KB sync bot may write.
items.why: Held here so git carries the plan, not only the db. The KB v2 design makes git the KB's origin, and a bot that syncs every 30 minutes needs a branch it is allowed to write. Own private repo with a bot-written main is clean; the fallback, kb/ inside zoltar-ranks on branch kb/sync, works but routes every KB sync through a merge you have to perform. This is the one place an agent would write a trunk, which is why it is not a fire's call. It gates t-20260908-kb-v2-cutover via depends_on, so nothing under it starts until it is answered.
items.acceptance: A reply event on t-20260908-kb-v2-repo-decision naming the repo; if own repo, the created URL posted in that reply, plus the OneDrive path confirmed and the Drive inbox/ and flat/ folders created.
